acceptance: Each stochastic channel absolute mean error <= 5*estimated_SE + numerical_oracle_floor, AND original fixed relative mean/RMSE ceilings both hold
oracle_mean_error_bound: Mixed-emitter cases use measured maximum coarse/fine relative channel mean delta times each reference mean; other cases use sqrt(3)*measured coarse/fine RGB RMSE (Cauchy-Schwarz bound). These are convergence estimates, not mathematical certified errors.
independence_assumption: Separate fixed seed streams and decorrelated per-pixel stochastic samples. Confidence interval describes Monte Carlo sampling only, not quadrature/model uncertainty.
